from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u075/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    blocks = []
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w - 1):
            if all(grid[rr][cc] == 2 for rr in (r, r + 1) for cc in (c, c + 1)):
                if (r, c) not in blocks:
                    blocks.append((r, c))
    for r, c in blocks:
        corners = [(r - 1, c - 1), (r - 1, c + 2), (r + 2, c - 1), (r + 2, c + 2)]
        if not all(0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w for rr, cc in corners):
            continue
        nw, ne, sw, se = [grid[rr][cc] for rr, cc in corners]
        colors = [sw, nw, se, ne]
        directions = [(-1, -1), (-1, 1), (1, -1), (1, 1)]
        for (rr, cc), color, (dr, dc) in zip(corners, colors, directions):
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = color
                rr += dr
                cc += dc
    return out
'''
file=programs/'task-9ba8b1ef.py'
file.write_text(code)
print(file)
